label: Exposed — slack water
injuries: Drained from holding the gates against their own tide

recentEvents.value: The water went slack all at once; the stranger saw the gates sag and declared that evil reveals its weakness.

unresolvedConflicts.value: Nothing here belongs to him. There is only a seat, still offered, going out.

temporaryObjective.value: Make the plainest offer a ferryman has: a seat on the boat out.
